title: Home Protection Supplement on Residential Natural Gas Supply Renewal Loyalty Credits
content:
**Rule.** For a Residential Natural Gas Supply renewal loyalty credit, the home protection supplement depends on the customer's Beacon Ridge Home Protection Plans plan at the gas agreement's premise: 5.00 when the plan is active and is Beacon Ridge Gas Line Guard, Beacon Ridge HVAC Repair Plan, Beacon Ridge HVAC Complete or Beacon Ridge Whole Home Shield, 2.50 when the plan is active and is any other protection plan, and no supplement when there is no active protection plan at that premise. The supplement, in US dollars, is added to the renewal loyalty credit owed.

The records read are the status, the plan name and the covered premise of the customer's Home Protection Plans plan; the premise must be the same premise as the gas agreement's.

| Home Protection Plans plan at the gas agreement's premise | Status | Supplement (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Gas Line Guard, Beacon Ridge HVAC Repair Plan, Beacon Ridge HVAC Complete or Beacon Ridge Whole Home Shield | active | 5.00 |
| any other protection plan (for instance Beacon Ridge Surge Shield, Beacon Ridge Electric Line Guard or Beacon Ridge Home Wiring Care) | active | 2.50 |
| any plan | not active | none |
| no protection plan at that premise | — | none |

### Cases (hypothetical customers)

- An active Beacon Ridge HVAC Complete plan at the gas premise: 5.00.
- An active Beacon Ridge Surge Shield at the gas premise: 2.50.
- An active Beacon Ridge Gas Line Guard at a different premise of the same customer, and nothing at the gas premise: none.
